name: PinegrapCMS
description: Open-source PHP CMS and enterprise web platform — page designer, e-commerce, erp, workspace with ai support, built-in WAF and bot protection. No Composer, no build step: upload, install, done.

paragraphs: Pinegrap is an open-source, all-in-one website platform written in PHP. A website with its own design, an online store, accounting (ERP), a team workspace and an external API live in one codebase, and a new site can be up in minutes from a ready-made design template.

Pinegrap grew out of LiveSite and has been developed by Kodpen since 2017. It runs wherever PHP runs, from a shared cPanel account to a dedicated IIS server, with no Composer step, no build pipeline and no outside service to set up.

requirements.text: It runs wherever PHP runs, from a shared cPanel account to a dedicated IIS server, with no Composer step, no build pipeline and no outside service to set up.

Sign-in and security: Sign in with Google, Microsoft or Apple, two-step sign-in, roles, and a built-in web application firewall with bot control, rate limits, country restriction and security headers.
